name: TRANSMISSION Esta Vida de Marinheiro-Paulo Miguel Antunes
description: This event is a film screening titled "The Sailor's Life," which traces the career of João Aguardela over two decades of Portuguese music. It includes archives, personal films, concert recordings, and interviews with family and friends.
longDescription:
TRANSMISSION Esta Vida de Marinheiro-Paulo Miguel Antunes is a film screening taking place at Teatro Municipal Constantino Nery in Porto on November 26, 2026, at 7:00 PM. The film, titled "The Sailor's Life," explores the musical journey of João Aguardela.

The screening runs for 89 minutes with no intermission. It features archival footage, personal films, concert recordings, and conversations with Aguardela's family and friends, covering his work with bands like Sitiados, Megafone, Linha da Frente, and A Naifa.

Admission to this event is free. The venue is located at Avenida Serpa Pinto 242, 4450-263 Matosinhos. Parking is available at Docapesca Parking for 1.05 euros with an event ticket.
